sources.title: parsec — 2× the context. ½ the cost.
sources.snippet: parsec compresses agent context per turn with a learned curator — in Claude Code, Codex, and opencode. Model traffic goes straight from your machine to your model provider — never through our cloud — and savings are measured per-request, never estimated.
